The plot thickens!

posts.name: TheSoundOfTrees
posts.cooked:
Crash-landing in the wilderness, only M’kk and a few others survived.

After helping hide the ship, M’kk volunteered to scout the area surrounding the crash site in hopes of finding food, shelter, and perhaps even sentient life. However, while searching the woods, the wounded ambassador was caught unprepared again as sirens approached from afar. Clearly, whatever was emitting those sounds could not be a welcoming party. As the blaring sirens grew closer to the wounded Maerynians, M’kk took a route far from the crash site, leaving a clear trail and drawing the pursuers away. M’kk was eventually apprehended by oddly dressed troops who declared themselves to be agents of the Federal Initiative to Limit Terrorism by Extraterrestrial Races. They detained their captive in a mobile prison and began the lengthy journey to the secretive F.I.L.T.E.R headquarters

There are other Maerynians on Earth than Tempest : the other few survivors. And we know nothing about them. While Tempest was away, they may have founded their own remote undersea base - or have taken residence in the ruins of Atlantis.

Maybe they also had an encounter with F.I.L.T.E.R. - deciding them to see humans as hostiles.

So, if Christopher decides so, it is always possible to have Maerynian villains showing up someday. Anyway, any super hero story sooner or later needs a "lost civilization" story  :D

The coral may be a hint, but I’m kinda picking up what thesoundoftrees is putting down, maybe this being is one of tempest’s people and after escaping Voss he’s received the same treatment from F.I.L.T.E.R. and as a base the alien has chosen Atlantis and has appropriated a lot of their abandoned tech, the armor/trident/coral growth. Speaking of that armor and trident I love the Black Manta vive I’m getting.

Also from a design perspective it doesn’t make too much sense to have two races that look too similar because it can be confusing to a viewer/reader unless of course it a party of their origins like the Romulans and Vulcans, which this could be another example of that, which is also cool. I guess in a drawn out way I’m just trying to say he’s a Maeyrnian, or at least an evolutionary out cultural cousin.

Although I can totally see a slight resemblance between the eyeball monsters and the font of power.

Atlanteans are weird.
